title: The World’s Most Conga Backside
author: Cory C.
desc: The purpose of the program is to bring up the hamstrings and back. This is very posterior chain heavy and requires high effort and is heavy volume.

ex.note: A couple of sets of 20 follow rpe then work up in weight. After that set of 10 do 20 more immediately. Pump blood in there some might start to be half reps that’s okay.
Put your feet a little higher if you want more hamstring and glute. Well keep our feet on the sled the entire time . Rest for about 20-30 seconds and do continuous work down to 10 reps
Strait 5x5. You have to push the weight , but a hard 5x5 on DL will make your whole backside grow.
20 reps each leg. Target that booty meat
Find a hard working weight do 2 sets of 10 then pump a set of 20 with same weight. If yo get a back pump you need squeeze glutes harder
On these do a 2 second hold during the contraction and 2 second during the stretch. After last set of 10 immediately pump out 20 with no hold
On these do a 2 second hold during the contraction and 2 second during the stretch. After last set of 10 immediately pump out 20 with no hold
If your back is weak start with body weight. Then over the 5 week add weight
Hold at top and bottom for 2 seconds after 3rd set of 10 pump out 20 with no hold
A couple sets of 20 to start the pump then three hard sets of 12 stretch at the top for a second an hold at the bottom for a half second. Not quite a pause rep
Find a weight for 10 . Go up do 10 more then use that weight to grind through 20
Use the chest supported Tbar if they have it. Let it pull your lats all the way down totally stretch that back. Make these heavy
Hold up top for 5 seconds let the weight stretch the trap at bottom
Rip 100 with short rest pause to start getting a pump. Then work through 3x 10 hard curls
Do a set of 10 take a step back do a set of 10 take a step back and do a set of 10 then at the end pump out 30.
Do a couple of warm ups first then Pump a set of 20 then do a set of 10 with a 2 second hold at the top and a 2 second stretch at bottom
Hard sets to pump blood into your legs
Add weight as needed to match rpe
Push the weight. Your back should be tired. I chose front squats because you can bail easier if needed. I put them towards the end to also lower the required weight to hit rpe.

ss.note: Targeting quads elevate the heels. Stretch at the bottom

ex.note: 2 sets of 20 with hard work. When you get to 10’s squeeze at the top for 2 seconds as hard as you can
Gunna keep on the “squeeze” theme. Hold each rep for 2 seconds at top and 2 seconds at bottom for a stretch.
3 hard sets of 12. At the last set of 12 cut the weight in half and double the reps
3 hard 8’s. For the 4th set put on weight you could do for 15 is with and pump out 30 to really fill up tri’s
Second hold at the top 3 second descend . Once they’re full rip a set of 20 to fill em up fuller than after staying the night with your uncle.
Just pumping blood into glutes. Most men that are doing this have likely neglected them
Keep going up in weight to match rpe I know it says amrap. I only want sets of 12 for the first 3 sets following the rpe. then do an amrap drop set after your last set of 12 using the weight you clim
Go high handle . This should give a good upper back and leg pump.
Work hard. A lot of people are afraid to progressive overload this movement. Don’t be afraid just use appropriate starting weight and build from there
